Fehlende C3-Urteile werden nach G2 behandelt. Das H2-Ergebnis ist kein Nachweis einer vollständigen Quellenprüfung.

amendments.note: Foundry route and no replay; H3 keeps two A6 fields with separate denominators.
C1 order/budget changed; primary populations and tests unchanged.
Sol-Flex-NoWrite is a separate execution condition; original 98 ratings retained.
Prospective whole-Joint rejection fallback for B4 V1; no rewrite of B3. Report rate/cost and AS not applicable.
Passage route not performed; 480 graph + 60 empty + 60 gold response positions. No claim against original passage reader.
Keep full original contexts unassessed after known invalid guard replies. Preserve paid replies and execute only originally unstarted jobs.
Fixed A-F judgment, separate K1-K6 Holm family, descriptive H4 components and efficiency. Primary G2 family unchanged. Individual prior C2 exposure disclosed.
Optional cost-stopped H1 prefix: pooled source ratios and paired two-stage source/original-group bootstrap. Approximate, not proven equal inclusion. C3 keeps G2 missingness.

Keep G2 primary H2 unchanged and additionally test sources with valid judgments in both contrast arms. H2/K2/K4 noninferiority needs both Holm analyses; H2/K5 superiority needs the additional analysis. No rerating or replay.

limits: SYNTHETIC preparation is not empirical evidence.
H1 and H2 unclear/technical missing judgments score symmetrically zero, not factual false.
H3 original A6 fields retain different denominators; no whole-statement multiplicity score identified.
QA missing values are unknown; no complete-case primary substitution.
Bootstrap CIs are marginal; K1-K6 form a separate secondary Holm family. Other ablations/strata/H3/EM remain descriptive.
One constructor model, selected reference meanings, no universal or schema-superiority claim.
N5 is a later construction rule; N6 passage endpoint is not performed.
N10 H1 uses an approximately probability-sampled cost-stopped prefix. Informative stopping is possible.
Unselected occurrences are not missing judgments. Empty sampled source/cells remain nonestimable with [0,1] sensitivity bounds.
N10 H1/K1/K3/K6 reuse one two-stage source/original-group matrix, without finite-population correction.
